<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0d0f1a;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    max-width: 100vw;
    max-height: 100vh;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    width: min(100vw, calc(100vh * 4 / 3));
    background: linear-gradient(#141833, #0a0c18);
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(80, 120, 255, 0.25);
    cursor: none;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const HUD_H = 40;

  // Level layouts: 0 = empty, 1 = normal brick, 2 = tough brick (2 hits)
  const LEVELS = [
    {
      speed: 6,
      layout: [
        "1111111111",
        "1111111111",
        "1111111111",
        "1111111111",
        "1111111111",
      ],
    },
    {
      speed: 7,
      layout: [
        "2222222222",
        "1100110011",
        "1121111211",
        "0112222110",
        "1121111211",
        "1100110011",
        "2222222222",
      ],
    },
  ];

  const ROW_COLORS = ["#ff5e7e", "#ff9f43", "#feca57", "#1dd1a1", "#48dbfb", "#5f9cff", "#a29bfe"];
  const TOUGH_COLOR = "#c8d0e0";
  const TOUGH_DAMAGED = "#7d8799";

  const BRICK_COLS = 10, BRICK_W = 70, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_GAP = 6;
  const BRICK_TOP = HUD_H + 40;
  const BRICK_LEFT = (W - (BRICK_COLS * BRICK_W + (BRICK_COLS - 1) * BRICK_GAP)) / 2;

  const paddle = { w: 110, h: 14, x: W / 2 - 55, y: H - 40, speed: 8 };
  const ball = { r: 8, x: 0, y: 0, dx: 0, dy: 0, speed: 6 };
  const keys = { left: false, right: false };

  let bricks = [];
  let score = 0;
  let lives = 3;
  let level = 0;
  let state = "title"; // title | serve | playing | paused | levelClear | gameOver | win

  function buildLevel(idx) {
    bricks = [];
    LEVELS[idx].layout.forEach((row, r) => {
      [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
        const hp = Number(ch);
        if (hp > 0) {
          bricks.push({
            x: BRICK_LEFT + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
            y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
            hp,
            maxHp: hp,
            color: ROW_COLORS[r % ROW_COLORS.length],
          });
        }
      });
    });
    ball.speed = LEVELS[idx].speed;
  }

  function resetBall() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
    ball.dx = 0;
    ball.dy = 0;
  }

  function newGame() {
    score = 0;
    lives = 3;
    level = 0;
    paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;
    buildLevel(level);
    resetBall();
    state = "serve";
  }

  function launch() {
    const angle = (Math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25) * Math.PI / 2; // small random tilt
    ball.dx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.dy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    state = "playing";
  }

  // One "action" input (Space / Enter / click) drives every screen transition
  function action() {
    switch (state) {
      case "title": newGame(); break;
      case "serve": launch(); break;
      case "paused": state = "playing"; break;
      case "levelClear":
        level++;
        buildLevel(level);
        resetBall();
        state = "serve";
        break;
      case "gameOver":
      case "win":
        newGame();
        break;
    }
  }

  function clampPaddle() {
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    switch (e.key) {
      case "ArrowLeft": case "a": case "A": keys.left = true; e.preventDefault(); break;
      case "ArrowRight": case "d": case "D": keys.right = true; e.preventDefault(); break;
      case " ": case "Enter": action(); e.preventDefault(); break;
      case "p": case "P":
        if (state === "playing") state = "paused";
        else if (state === "paused") state = "playing";
        break;
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    switch (e.key) {
      case "ArrowLeft": case "a": case "A": keys.left = false; break;
      case "ArrowRight": case "d": case "D": keys.right = false; break;
    }
  });

  function pointerToPaddle(clientX) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    paddle.x = x - paddle.w / 2;
    clampPaddle();
  }
  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => pointerToPaddle(e.clientX));
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); action(); });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    pointerToPaddle(e.touches[0].clientX);
    action();
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    pointerToPaddle(e.touches[0].clientX);
  }, { passive: false });

  // ---------- Physics ----------
  function hitBrick(b) {
    b.hp--;
    if (b.hp <= 0) {
      score += b.maxHp > 1 ? 50 : 10;
    } else {
      score += 10;
    }
  }

  function collideBricks() {
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (b.hp <= 0) continue;
      const nearestX = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + BRICK_W));
      const nearestY = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + BRICK_H));
      const distX = ball.x - nearestX;
      const distY = ball.y - nearestY;
      if (distX * distX + distY * distY > ball.r * ball.r) continue;

      // Reflect on the axis of smaller penetration
      const overlapX = Math.min(ball.x + ball.r - b.x, b.x + BRICK_W - (ball.x - ball.r));
      const overlapY = Math.min(ball.y + ball.r - b.y, b.y + BRICK_H - (ball.y - ball.r));
      if (overlapX < overlapY) {
        ball.dx = ball.x < b.x + BRICK_W / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.dx) : Math.abs(ball.dx);
      } else {
        ball.dy = ball.y < b.y + BRICK_H / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.dy) : Math.abs(ball.dy);
      }
      hitBrick(b);
      return true; // only one brick per step
    }
    return false;
  }

  function stepBall(frac) {
    ball.x += ball.dx * frac;
    ball.y += ball.dy * frac;

    // Walls
    if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.dx = Math.abs(ball.dx); }
    if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.dx = -Math.abs(ball.dx); }
    if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.dy = Math.abs(ball.dy); }

    // Paddle
    if (ball.dy > 0 &&
        ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y &&
        ball.y - ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
        ball.x + ball.r >= paddle.x &&
        ball.x - ball.r <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2); // -1..1
      const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit)) * (Math.PI / 3); // up to 60°
      ball.dx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
      ball.dy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
    }

    collideBricks();

    // Ball lost
    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) {
        state = "gameOver";
      } else {
        resetBall();
        state = "serve";
      }
      return false;
    }

    if (bricks.every((b) => b.hp <= 0)) {
      score += 500;
      state = level < LEVELS.length - 1 ? "levelClear" : "win";
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function update(dt) {
    if (state === "serve" || state === "playing") {
      if (keys.left) paddle.x -= paddle.speed * dt;
      if (keys.right) paddle.x += paddle.speed * dt;
      clampPaddle();
    }
    if (state === "serve") {
      resetBall();
    } else if (state === "playing") {
      // Sub-step so the ball never tunnels through bricks
      const dist = Math.hypot(ball.dx, ball.dy) * dt;
      const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dist / 4));
      for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
        if (!stepBall(dt / steps)) break;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- Rendering ----------
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawHeart(x, y, s, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(x, y, x - s / 2, y, x - s / 2, y + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(x - s / 2, y + s * 0.6, x, y + s * 0.8, x, y + s);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(x, y + s * 0.8, x + s / 2, y + s * 0.6, x + s / 2, y + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + s / 2, y, x, y, x, y + s * 0.3);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px Segoe UI, Arial";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 16, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(`Level ${level + 1}/${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("Lives", W - 100, HUD_H / 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      drawHeart(W - 80 + i * 26, 11, 18, i < lives ? "#ff4d6d" : "#3a3f55");
    }
  }

  function drawBricks() {
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (b.hp <= 0) continue;
      let color = b.color;
      if (b.maxHp > 1) color = b.hp > 1 ? TOUGH_COLOR : TOUGH_DAMAGED;
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, BRICK_W, BRICK_H, 4);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)";
      ctx.fillRect(b.x + 3, b.y + 3, BRICK_W - 6, 4);
      if (b.maxHp > 1 && b.hp === 1) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + 20, b.y + 4);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + 32, b.y + 12);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + 28, b.y + 18);
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + 50, b.y + 5);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + 44, b.y + 14);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawPaddle() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, paddle.y, 0, paddle.y + paddle.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#9ad0ff");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#3d7bff");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBall() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.shadowColor = "#9ad0ff";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  function overlay(title, lines) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5, 8, 20, 0.72)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "bold 52px Segoe UI, Arial";
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 50);
    ctx.font = "20px Segoe UI, Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c9d4ff";
    lines.forEach((line, i) => ctx.fillText(line, W / 2, H / 2 + 10 + i * 30));
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawBricks();
    drawPaddle();
    drawBall();
    drawHUD();

    switch (state) {
      case "title":
        overlay("BRICK BREAKER", [
          "Move: mouse or ← / → (A / D)",
          "Launch: click or Space   •   Pause: P",
          "Click or press Space to start",
        ]);
        break;
      case "serve":
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.fillStyle = "#c9d4ff";
        ctx.font = "18px Segoe UI, Arial";
        ctx.fillText("Click or press Space to launch", W / 2, H - 90);
        break;
      case "paused":
        overlay("PAUSED", ["Press P, Space or click to resume"]);
        break;
      case "levelClear":
        overlay(`LEVEL ${level + 1} CLEAR!`, [`Score: ${score}`, "Click or press Space for the next level"]);
        break;
      case "gameOver":
        overlay("GAME OVER", [`Final score: ${score}`, "Click or press Space to play again"]);
        break;
      case "win":
        overlay("YOU WIN!", [`Final score: ${score}`, "Click or press Space to play again"]);
        break;
    }
  }

  // ---------- Main loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / (1000 / 60), 3); // 1.0 = one 60fps frame
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  buildLevel(0);
  resetBall();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
